test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the maximum length of a cricket bat?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​38 inches.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The overall length of the bat, when the bottom part of the handle is inserted, shall not be **more than 38 in/96.52 cm. Edges: 1.56in / 4.0cm.**
 
• Cricket bats come in** various sizes for obvious reasons. **
 
• The most important element when choosing a particular size is the** age and height **of the person using them.
 
• Choosing the right bat is the main for a **young player's growth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The motive of the batsmen is to **score runs.**
 
• One of the important cricket rules is that for **batsmen to score runs they must run to each other's end of the pitch (from one end to the other). In doing this one run is scored.​ **
